note: East Asia (东亚): hand-written places, one node or edge per line. See docs/places.md.

name: Taiwan
intro: Home to Austronesian peoples for thousands of years; from the 1600s ruled in turn by the Dutch, the Spanish, the Zheng family, the Qing, Japan and the Republic of China.
intro_zh: 南岛语族先民居住数千年，十七世纪起先后由荷兰、西班牙、明郑、清朝、日本和中华民国管治。

notes.zh: 此前没有国家政权，岛上是各原住民族群。地图上的空白不等于无人居住。
notes.en: No state held the island before this; it was home to many indigenous peoples. Blank on the map does not mean empty.

notes.zh: 《马关条约》割让给日本，1945年日本投降后由中华民国接收。
notes.en: Ceded to Japan by the Treaty of Shimonoseki; taken over by the Republic of China after Japan's surrender in 1945.

notes.zh: 1949年起由中华民国政府管治。中华人民共和国主张台湾是其领土的一部分；两岸对主权各有主张，国际上对此立场不一。
notes.en: Governed by the Republic of China since 1949. The People's Republic of China claims Taiwan as part of its territory; the two sides hold different positions on sovereignty, and other countries' positions vary.

name: Xinjiang
intro: The Western Regions of old: oasis city-states and steppe powers rose and fell here; the Han, Tang, Yuan and Qing governed it at times, and it became a province in 1884.
intro_zh: 古称西域，绿洲城邦与草原游牧政权交替兴衰，汉、唐、元、清曾在此设官管辖，1884年建省。

notes.zh: 喀什一带曾成立“东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国”，存在不足一年。
notes.en: An East Turkestan Islamic Republic existed around Kashgar for under a year.

notes.zh: 伊犁、塔城、阿山三区成立“东突厥斯坦共和国”，与国民政府对峙，1949年并入中华人民共和国。
notes.en: The Three Districts (Ili, Tarbagatai, Altai) formed a Second East Turkestan Republic, opposing the Nationalist government; it joined the People's Republic of China in 1949.

name: Turpan Basin
intro: Home of Jushi and the Gaochang kingdom; the Tang made it Xizhou after conquering Gaochang, then it became the Uyghur kingdom of Qocho, and turned Muslim after the 1300s.
intro_zh: 车师、高昌国的故地。唐灭高昌设西州，此后为回鹘高昌王国，十四世纪后伊斯兰化。

name: Ili Valley
intro: Land of the Wusun, later a centre of the Western Turks, the Chagatai Khanate and the Dzungars; the Qing governed all Xinjiang from here through the General of Ili.
intro_zh: 乌孙故地，后为西突厥、察合台汗国和准噶尔的中心。清朝在此设伊犁将军，统辖新疆。

notes.zh: 俄国占领伊犁，1881年《伊犁条约》后归还大部分地区。
notes.en: Occupied by Russia; most of it was returned under the Treaty of Saint Petersburg (1881).

name: Tibet
intro: The Tibetan Empire united the plateau in the 600s–800s and then broke apart; from the Yuan onward, dynasties based in China ruled or oversaw it in different ways, and the nature of each period's relationship is debated by historians.
intro_zh: 吐蕃王朝在七至九世纪统一高原，此后分裂；元朝起中原王朝以不同方式管辖或羁縻，各时期的关系性质学界有争论。

notes.zh: 明朝与西藏的关系是否构成主权管辖，学界有争论；本图明代未把西藏画入明朝。
notes.en: Whether the Ming held sovereignty over Tibet is debated; this atlas leaves Tibet outside the Ming on its maps.

notes.zh: 清亡后西藏地方政府实际自治，中华民国主张西藏为其领土。
notes.en: After the fall of the Qing the Tibetan government ruled itself in practice; the Republic of China claimed Tibet as its territory.

notes.zh: 1951年《十七条协议》后由中华人民共和国管辖。
notes.en: Governed by the People's Republic of China since the Seventeen Point Agreement of 1951.

name: Northeast China (Manchuria)
intro: Sushen, Buyeo, Goguryeo, Balhae, the Liao and the Jin rose here in turn; the Manchus founded the Later Jin here before taking China as the Qing.
intro_zh: 肃慎、扶余、高句丽、渤海、辽、金等政权先后兴起于此，满洲人在这里建立后金，入关建立清朝。

notes.zh: 日本扶植“满洲国”，国际联盟不予承认。
notes.en: Japan set up the puppet state of Manchukuo, which the League of Nations refused to recognise.

name: Liaodong Peninsula
intro: The Liaodong commandery of Yan, Qin and Han, fought over by Goguryeo and the Sui and Tang; in modern times ceded to Japan and returned, then leased to Russia and to Japan.
intro_zh: 燕、秦汉辽东郡之地，高句丽与隋唐在此争夺。近代先后被日本割占又归还、被俄国和日本租借。

notes.zh: 《马关条约》割让给日本，俄、德、法三国干涉后清朝赎回。
notes.en: Ceded to Japan by the Treaty of Shimonoseki, then bought back by the Qing after Russia, Germany and France intervened.
Port Arthur and Dalian leased to Russia.

notes.zh: 日俄战争后转由日本租借（关东州）。
notes.en: Leased to Japan after the Russo-Japanese War (the Kwantung Leased Territory).

name: Outer Manchuria
intro: North of the Amur and east of the Ussuri: held by the Qing under the Treaty of Nerchinsk (1689), then ceded to Russia by the treaties of Aigun (1858) and Peking (1860).
intro_zh: 黑龙江以北、乌苏里江以东，清朝依 1689年《尼布楚条约》领有，1858年《瑷珲条约》和 1860年《北京条约》割让给俄国。

notes.zh: 中国史学界通常称这两个条约为不平等条约。
notes.en: Chinese historians generally count these among the unequal treaties.

name: Outer Mongolia
intro: The heartland of the Xiongnu, Turkic, Uyghur and Mongol empires; Khalkha Mongolia under the Qing; today the State of Mongolia.
intro_zh: 匈奴、突厥、回鹘、蒙古等草原帝国的腹地，清朝时为喀尔喀蒙古，今为蒙古国。

notes.zh: 1911年宣布独立，中华民国直到 1946年才承认。
notes.en: Declared independence in 1911; the Republic of China recognised it only in 1946.

name: Hexi Corridor
intro: The passage between the Qilian Mountains and the desert, the throat of the Silk Road; held in turn by the Yuezhi, Xiongnu, Han, the Five Liang states, Tibet, the Guiyi Circuit and Western Xia.
intro_zh: 祁连山与沙漠之间的通道，丝绸之路的咽喉，月氏、匈奴、汉、五凉、吐蕃、归义军、西夏先后据有。

name: Yunnan
intro: The land of ancient Dian; independent as Nanzhao under the Tang and Dali under the Song, until the Yuan conquered Dali and made it a province.
intro_zh: 古滇国之地，唐时南诏、宋时大理独立建国，元朝灭大理后设云南行省。

name: Hainan
intro: Home of the Li people's ancestors; Emperor Wu of Han set up commanderies here, and it was long a place of exile for officials.
intro_zh: 黎族先民的家园，汉武帝时设珠崖、儋耳二郡，后来长期是贬官流放之地。

name: Sakhalin
intro: Home of the Ainu, Nivkh and others; the Yuan, Ming and Qing held loose sway over its peoples; Russian after 1860, with the south Japanese from 1905 to 1945.
intro_zh: 阿伊努人、尼夫赫人等的家园，元明清曾羁縻其部落，1860年后归俄国，南半部 1905–1945年属日本。

name: Arunachal Pradesh / South Tibet
name_zh: 阿鲁纳恰尔邦 / 藏南

name: Southern Kurils / Northern Territories
name_zh: 南千岛群岛 / 北方四岛
